name: ironurn
description: IronUrn Trivia — a free, unlimited, account-free baseball trivia platform (Pinpoint clone) built to run entirely on Cloudflare's free tier.

scripts.build: npm --workspace apps/web run build && node scripts/bake-data.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck && npm --workspace workers/api run typecheck
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm --workspace workers/api run deploy
